items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: Paraboschi was replaced by a drummer named Robert Barnet

ctx.x: Felix Leclerc was a very quiet and nice person to be with. Jack Gauthier, gay and full of life but André Claveau was very temperamental and playing big star. The show was often back stage as much as in the hall and it was very funny.

We came back to Paris the 11th of September and I started working at the Club St. Germain des Prés the 17th. Claude Bolling made some changes in his band and a trombone player named Charles Huss replaced Benny Wasseur.
